info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Operational Services Processing Order By Processing Order Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables the modification of banking operational service processing orders identified by their unique processing order ID. It allows authorized users to adjust various attributes of an existing order to reflect changes in status, details, or requirements. Typical consumers include banking staff and automated systems that manage operational workflows. By providing efficient updating capabilities, it streamlines order management and enhances operational efficiency.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific processing order identified by the resource ID 'RES-100045'. Utilize this operation to modify any relevant attributes of the order, ensuring it's up-to-date and accurate.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the processing order with ID RES-100045. This should contain the necessary fields to perform a partial update, ensuring that only the intended changes are applied without affecting other existing fields.

200.description: The request was successful, and the processing order has been updated.
